title: How Long Would You Last in the Age of T. Rex? #shorts
description_hook: You wake up in the age of T. rex: a year has 372 days, and something 13 meters long has already seen you.

beats.say: How long would you last in the age of T. rex? You wake up in a world where a year has 372 days.
beats.img: a lone human silhouette standing at the edge of a steaming prehistoric fern forest at dawn, giant conifers, hazy orange light, vertical frame

beats.say: Then the ferns move. Something 13 meters long is watching you. You are no longer the top of anything.
beats.img: the huge shadowy head of a tyrannosaur emerging between towering ferns, one amber eye catching the light, misty humid forest, low angle

beats.say: Good news: it can probably only walk, about 12 miles per hour. Bad news: if it catches you, up to 34,522 newtons of bite.
beats.img: a massive tyrannosaur striding through a shallow river valley in late afternoon haze, heavy legs splashing water, seen from far behind

beats.say: And night comes early. A day here lasts only 23.5 hours. In the dark, something big is still awake.
beats.img: a dark prehistoric swamp under a huge rising moon, silhouettes of giant ferns, a faint massive shape moving between the trees

gumi.say: Gumi's odds: 25 percent. Stay still, stay quiet, and hope it already ate.
